candidate.answerReason: A rectangle with side ratio 4:3 has diagonal ratio 5. Its width is therefore 27(4/5)=21.6 inches, whose nearest listed value is 21.5 inches, matching D.

methods.label: Scale a 3-4-5 right triangle
methods.explanation:
The diagonal and two sides form a right triangle. Represent the horizontal length and height as \(4t\) and \(3t\), where \(t>0\), to preserve the given ratio.

By the Pythagorean theorem, the diagonal has length
\[
\sqrt{(4t)^2+(3t)^2}=5t.
\]
A \(27\)-inch screen has diagonal \(27\), so \(5t=27\). Its horizontal length is
\[
4t=4\cdot\frac{27}{5}=21.6\text{ inches}.
\]
The neighboring choices \(21.5\) and \(22\) are \(0.1\) and \(0.4\) inch away, respectively; all other choices are farther away. Thus the closest listed length is \(\boxed{21.5}\) inches, choice D.
